draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Nagpur! Just a couple of minutes from here stands the Zero Mile Stone, built by the British in 1907 during the Great Trigonometrical Survey to mark the centre of India.
draft.hungryLine: Nagpur is a great food town, so try the Saoji chicken, and you're right in Ramdaspeth, home of 10 Downing Street for continental food.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Zero Mile Stone is a 2 minute walk, Sitabuldi Fort is 6 minutes, and the Nagpur Central Museum is about 7 minutes away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Phutala Lake in the evening for snacks with a lake view.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Nagpur sits right at the geographic centre of India's nine major metros, from Mumbai and Delhi to Kochi and Kolkata.

spots.name: Zero Mile Stone
spots.detail: 2 min walk · A sandstone pillar with four stucco horses marking the centre of colonial India

spots.name: Sitabuldi Fort
spots.detail: 6 min walk · Hilltop fort where the Battle of Sitabuldi was fought in 1817

spots.name: Nagpur Central Museum
spots.detail: 7 min walk · 'Ajab Bangala', with dinosaur fossils, coins and tribal artefacts

legends.title: The Sufi of Civil Lines
legends.body: Meetha Neem Dargah is the resting place of the Sufi saint Sayyad Jalaluddin Meer Surkh. Locals say he was a disciple of Tajuddin Baba of Nagpur.

tips.title: Visit Sonegaon Lake in winter.
tips.body: That's when migratory birds show up there.

tips.title: Use the metro.
tips.body: Sitabuldi is the interchange between the Orange and Aqua lines, and Kasturchand Park station is close by.

story.title: Bhonsle capital
story.body: Nagpur was the capital of the Kingdom of Nagpur, ruled by the Maratha Bhonsle dynasty. It was one of the kingdoms of the Maratha Empire.

story.title: The British take over
story.body: After the Battle of Sitabuldi, a treaty in 1818 handed the Sitabuldi hills to the British. Nagpur was annexed in 1853 and became Nagpur Province.

story.title: Capital of the Central Provinces
story.body: Nagpur became the main winter capital of the new Central Provinces. The Central Museum opened in 1863 and the Zero Mile Stone went up in 1907.

story.title: Winter capital
story.body: When Vidarbha joined Maharashtra, the Nagpur Pact made the city the state's winter capital. The Legislature still holds its winter session at Vidhan Bhavan.

story.title: Orange city
story.body: Nagpur is famous for its oranges and its metro now criss-crosses the centre. Sitabuldi station opened in 2019.
